SELECT table_name,column_name,datatype,description
FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns
WHERE table_name IN ('ls_dr9.tractor_n','ls_dr9.tractor_s')
AND column_name IN
('release','brickid','objid','brickname','brick_primary',
'ra','dec','ra_ivar','dec_ivar')
ORDER BY table_name,column_name

SELECT brickname,COUNT(*) AS source_count
FROM ls_dr9.tractor_n
WHERE brick_primary = 1
AND brickname IN
('1897p342','1898p345','1900p340','1901p342','1901p345','1903p340','1904p342','2252p305','2254p307','2255p302','2255p305','2257p302','2257p307','2258p305')
GROUP BY brickname
ORDER BY brickname

SELECT brickname,COUNT(*) AS source_count
FROM ls_dr9.tractor_s
WHERE brick_primary = 1
AND brickname IN
('1897p342','1898p345','1900p340','1901p342','1901p345','1903p340','1904p342','2252p305','2254p307','2255p302','2255p305','2257p302','2257p307','2258p305')
GROUP BY brickname
ORDER BY brickname
